agents.recommendation: Use the sky as evidence only. The relationship proof is his attention shifting toward her.
Stage a camera move from big-world awe to private noticedness to tactile home.
Block any output where the first slide becomes a landscape poster or the second slide loses his eye-line.

options.name: Zoom-Out To Attention Pivot
options.case_for: Best satisfies creator request for zoom-out/zoom-in psychology while preserving A Story emotional proof.
options.risk: Needs careful identity and eye-line prompt control.

options.name: Wide-Wide-Close
options.risk: Two wide slides slow the emotional reveal.

options.name: Close-Medium-Wide
options.risk: Contradicts the requested zoom-out to go-in journey.

selector_verdict: Use wide -> medium -> close. The psychological reveal must be: the world is big, but he chooses to look at her, so the small world becomes enough.
rejected_visual_patterns: repeating the exact screenshot composition across all slides
shooting star as the whole premise
minimal quote-card with tiny couple silhouette

final_visual_plan.copy: Not every love story needs a big life.
final_visual_plan.visual: Extreme wide open-sky/seaside scene; couple small but emotionally readable in lower frame; her wonder begins and his posture angles toward her.

final_visual_plan.copy: She points at the sky. He looks at her first.
final_visual_plan.visual: Medium side/back view; her hand points up and face glows; his eye-line clearly rests on her expression.
Close tactile frame of hands/shoulders/shared object while walking back; background fades, world narrows to the two of them.
